stories.title: Lawsuit alleges 6-year-old boy with autism repeatedly left alone in cinder block room, padded closet at Allen County school
stories.summary: According to the complaint, the boy was repeatedly shut alone in rooms at the school whenever his disability would cause him to cry, scream or leave his classroom.

stories.title: Indy Ignite break ground on new headquarters, first dedicated facility for MLV team
stories.summary: Scheduled to open in 2028, the Fishers Fieldhouse is a $65-million project right next to the home court of the Ignite, the Fishers Event Center.

stories.title: Woman arrested after self-driving Tesla crashes into construction equipment while she was allegedly intoxicated in western Indiana
stories.summary: When troopers arrived on the scene, they found two arrow boards that were directing traffic struck by a Tesla.

stories.title: New Indiana scholarship targets students at risk of not completing degrees
stories.summary: Nonprofit financial aid firm INvestEd launches scholarship for college juniors and seniors.

stories.title: Annual turkey giveaway helps families prepare for Thanksgiving dinner
stories.summary: Living in the Moment Professional Hub partnered with Youth Empowering Youth to give away items for Thanksgiving dinner to families in need.

stories.title: 'Does the board care?' | Parents speak out at IPS meeting on possible closures, consolidations
stories.summary: The board heard concerns from families about the district's future Thursday night — a future that could include school closures and consolidations.

stories.title: Elwood athletic director says they have raised enough money to keep sports for the 2026-2027 school year
stories.summary: The school that rallied to recruit football players to save their season and then had athletics on the chopping block after a failed referendum is thanking donors.

stories.title: Construction underway on part of Keystone Avenue after fatal crash review team recommendations
stories.summary: Crews are reconstructing the median near the intersection of Keystone Avenue and 62nd Street to change how drivers turn out of the businesses.

stories.title: Indy man sentenced to 18 years after pleading guilty in man's 2024 overdose death
stories.summary: Shane Johns pleaded guilty to reckless homicide and dealing in a narcotic drug in court on Monday, Nov. 16.

stories.title: 35 people charged federally as part of 'Operation Circle City Shield' in Indianapolis
stories.summary: U.S. Attorney Tom Wheeler announced Thursday that 35 people have been charged with federal firearms, drug trafficking and other offenses as part of the operation.

stories.title: 'His leadership extended beyond City Hall' | Former Richmond, Indiana mayor dies at 96
stories.summary: Former Mayor, Clifford J. Dickman died Nov. 15 at the age of 96. He served as mayor from 1976 to 1983.

stories.title: Delaware County prosecutor finds Muncie officer justified in fatal shooting during standoff
stories.summary: Prosecutor Eric Hoffman said the officer's actions were "completely and legally justified" under Indiana law.
